params.name: start_date
params.description: Start date for the change window (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to yesterday.

params.name: end_date
params.description: End date for the change window (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

params.name: currencies
params.description: Comma-separated ISO 4217 currency codes to report on.

params.name: source
params.description:
Three-letter ISO 4217 source/base currency code. Defaults to USD on the Free
plan; any source currency may be selected on Basic plan and above.

items.docs:
Returns currency change parameters (start rate, end rate, absolute change,
percentage change) between two dates for any supported currency pair.
Available on Enterprise Plus plan and above.
